# 密码二次验证

### 回忆
- 上次解决了用户名字符串长度控制问题
	- 后端控制了之后
	- 再在前端先验证
	- 这样前后端都验证
	- 前端负责高效
	- 后端负责保险
- 但是有的时候密码要求比较高
	- 不但要求有大写小写数字和符号
	- 还要求输入两次比对一下
- 这怎么做呢?🤔

### prepareInsert.html
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
	<head>
		<meta http-equiv="content-Type" content="text/html;charset=utf-8"/>
		<title>prepareInsert</title>
	</head>
	<body>
		<form id="RegistForm" onsubmit="return doSubmit()" action="./insert" method="post">
			用户:<input id="username" name="username" type="text" />
			<br/>
			密码:<input id="password" name="password" type="text" />
			<br/>
			<input type="submit"  value="注册" >
			<input type="reset" value="重置" >
		</form>
	</body>
	<script>
		function doSubmit(){
			var username = document.getElementById("username");
			if(username.value.length>10){
				alert("用户名有"+username.value.length+",请不要超过10位");
				return false;
			}
			else{
				var form = document.getElementById("RegistForm");
				form.submit();
			}
		}
	</script>
</html>
```

- 现在要求密码中必须含有大写小写和数字
- 应该怎么办呢？

### 搜索

![图片描述](data:image/png;base64,)

![图片描述](data:image/png;base64,)

- 这个正则表达式如何理解呢？

### 理解

![图片描述](data:image/png;base64,)

- 大写小写数字都要有
- 不论次序
- 总长度8-16
- 我们应该修改8-16


### 修复改代码
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
	<head>
		<meta http-equiv="content-Type" content="text/html;charset=utf-8"/>
		<title>prepareInsert</title>
	</head>
	<body>
		<form id="RegistForm" onsubmit="return doSubmit()" action="./insert" method="post">
			用户名:<input id="username" name="username" type="text" />
			<br/>
			密码:<input id="password" name="password" type="text" />
			<br/>
			<input type="submit" value="注册" >
			<input type="reset" value="重置" >
		</form>
		<span id="errormsg" style="color:red;"></span>
	</body>
	<script>
		function doSubmit(){
			var username = document.getElementById("username");
			var password = document.getElementById("password");
		    var re = /^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)[^]{8,16}$/;
			var result=  re.test(password.value);
			if(username.value.length>10){
				var errormsg = document.getElementById("errormsg");
				errormsg.innerHTML = "用户名长度:"+username.value.length+"，不能超过十";
				return false;
			}
			else if(!result){
				var errormsg = document.getElementById("errormsg");
				errormsg.innerHTML = "密码必须由数字和大小写字母组成";
				return false;
			}
			else{
				var form = document.getElementById("RegistForm");
				form.submit();
			}
		}
	</script>
</html>
```

- 现在还需要重复一下密码进行验证

### 重复密码进行验证

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
	<head>
		<meta http-equiv="content-Type" content="text/html;charset=utf-8"/>
		<title>prepareInsert</title>
	</head>
	<body>
		<form id="RegistForm" onsubmit="return doSubmit()" action="./insert" method="post">
			用户名:<input id="username" name="username" type="text" />
			<br/>
			密码:<input id="password" name="password" type="text" />
			<br/>			
			再次验证密码:<input id="password2" name="password2" type="text" />
			<br/>
			<input type="submit" value="注册" >
			<input type="reset" value="重置" >
		</form>
		<span id="errormsg" style="color:red;"></span>
	</body>
	<script>
		function doSubmit(){
			var username = document.getElementById("username");
			var password = document.getElementById("password");
			var password2 = document.getElementById("password2");
		    var re = /^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)[^]{8,16}$/;
			var errormsg = document.getElementById("errormsg");
			var result=  re.test(password.value);
			if(username.value.length>10){
				errormsg.innerHTML = "用户名长度:"+username.value.length+"，不能超过十";
				return false;
			}
			else if(password.value!=password2.value){
				errormsg.innerHTML = "两次输入的密码不一致";
				return false;
			}

			else if(!result){
				errormsg.innerHTML = "密码必须由数字和大小写字母组成";
				return false;
			}
			else{
				var form = document.getElementById("RegistForm");
				form.submit();
			}
		}
	</script>
</html>
```

### 美化一下

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
	<head>
		<meta http-equiv="content-Type" content="text/html;charset=utf-8"/>
		<title>Login</title>
		<style>
			form > span{
				width: 120px;
				display: inline-block;
			}
		</style>
	</head>
	<body>
		<h1>login</h1>
		<form id="LoginForm" onsubmit="return doSubmit()" action="./insert" method="post">
			<span>username</span><input id="username" name="username" type="text" />
			<br/>
			<span>password</span><input id="password" name="password" type="text" />
			<br/>
			<span>password2</span><input id="password" name="password" type="text" />
			<br/>
			<input type="submit" value="submit" >
			<input type="reset" value="reset" >
		</form>
		<span id="errormsg" style="color:red;"></span>
	</body>
	<script>
		function doSubmit(){
			var username = document.getElementById("username");
			var password = document.getElementById("password");
			var password2 = document.getElementById("password2");
		    var re = /^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)[^]{8,16}$/;
			var errormsg = document.getElementById("errormsg");
			var result=  re.test(password.value);
			if(username.value.length>10){
				errormsg.innerHTML = "username:"+username.value.length+"more than 10!";
				return false;
			}
			else if(!result){
				errormsg.innerHTML = "password must contain upper,lower and number,size in [3,10]";
				return false;
			}
			else{
				var form = document.getElementById("LoginForm");
				form.submit();
			}
		}
	</script>
</html>
```


### 总结
- 这次二次确认了密码
- 并且确认密码
	- 必须得有大写小字和数字
	- 8-16个字符
- 这样插入用户名密码都比较规范了
- InsertServlet和SelectServlet都需要连接数据库
	- 如果数据库改密码需要改两个文件
	- 能否把数据库连接封装一下
	- 这样就改数据库用户名密码就容易多了
	- 怎么改呢?🤔
